name: aistats-skills
description: A 12-skill depth pack for AISTATS submissions: topic fit, OpenReview submission checks, author discussion, camera-ready, artifacts, reproducibility, supplementary material, review process, writing style, related work, experiments, and workflow. Grounded in the official AISTATS 2027 CFP, Submission FAQ, rebuttal guidelines, OpenReview group, PMLR proceedings pages, and Code of Conduct re-verified on 2026-11-23.
